title: Versioned receipt hash test vectors for cross-language verification
done_when: make check passes with tests verifying every vector in conformance-draft/receipt_vectors.json against tessera.receipts.receipt_hash and canonical_json
constraints: Read AGENTS.md first; the spec wins over the code
Never edit conformance/ or conformance.lock, and never weaken an existing test

Include schema_version, spec_section, and cases covering nested keys, UTF-8 text, nulls, booleans, fractions, whole floats (1.0 -> 1 below 2^53), empty collections, and failed submits with error strings
No key, token or credential in any response, page, log or commit
Run make check before committing; one task per branch; do not push
notes: Each vector stores input (task_id, fencing_token, ok, output, error), canonical_json and expected sha256 so JavaScript and TypeScript clients can verify SHA-256 receipts byte-for-byte.
